description: Variation of conditions 2 (approved plans), 3 (external construction detailing), 21 (evidence of Energy Statement compliance), 26 (plant equipment and trunking details), 29 (noise and vibration attenuation and ventilation) and 35 (lighting scheme) of planning permission ref. 26/00385/VOC (Variation of conditions 29, 31 and 32 and the removal of condition 13 of planning permission ref; 24/02107/FUL (Demolition of the buildings and redevelopment of the site, involving the erection of 4 storey building to provide commercial unit at ground floor and 7 residential units on the upper floors, together with the provision of cycle and refuse stores, plus ASHP and commercial A/C units at roof top.) Granted on 07.01.2026. Amendment sought: Noise levels in commercial, residential and amenity areas.), granted on 23/07/2026Variation sought:Condition 2: Amendments to the approved plans, including revisions to windows and doors, internal layouts, plant and storage arrangements, rooflights, parapet details, amenity spaces and the indicative location of PV panels. Condition 3: Revised external construction details to reflect the amended plans, including windows, doors, materials, parapets, vents, rainwater goods, landscaping and enclosure details. Condition 21: Replacement of the approved Energy Statement with an updated Energy Statement and associated evidence of energy compliance. Condition 26: Revised plant, ventilation, ducting and associated equipment details to reflect the amended scheme. Condition 29: Revised noise attenuation, glazing, ventilation and overheating mitigation measures to reflect the amended scheme. Condition 35: Revised external lighting details to reflect the amended elevations, access arrangements and lighting layout.
